title: measurement-drains-the-review-lane

decisions.text: A berth whose ticket has crossed into a terminal cursor (PROVED, SUPERSEDED, RETIRED, DROPPED, KILLED, ABSORBED) is not awaiting his review; it drains by measurement, not by his click.
decisions.by: derived from CLAUDE.md Law 9 (ruling 2026-08-15: 'anything settled by measurment trumps approvals by even me') applied to Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'i don't have to approve them because we know they'll build as we meant'

decisions.text: The drain is one new predicate inside pending_reviews in cairn/machines/skill_block/skill_block.py, evaluated after the AUTO_DRAIN_SKILLS check; no second lane, no new store.
decisions.by: derived from cairn/machines/skill_block/skill_block.py:378-391 (the existing auto-drain seam) and memory saveslates-dont-need-review

decisions.text: A berth finds its ticket from the ticket side: ticket-v1 carries intent_berth and sorted_berth as berth paths; the berth doc carries finding_id; the map is berth path -> ticket. The idea berth is found by from_idea id against the idea berth doc's recorded id.

decisions.text: A berth whose ticket is unreadable, or that no ticket names, stays pending. An unreadable record never reads as drained.
decisions.by: derived from CLAUDE.md Law 7 (a record of truth never collapses an error)

decisions.text: Nothing writes the reviewed log. The drain is a read-time filter; his log stays byte-identical.
decisions.by: derived from CLAUDE.md Law 6 (the owner alone gates writes) — the reviewed log is his

decisions.text: Live troubles render under a CC-owned lane after the operator sections, headed the way the OPEN QUESTIONS lane is ('CC owns these'); the trouble count stays in the banner header so Law 7 loudness is kept.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'that leaves me ideas and intentions only' — troubles are deterministic reds and CC's to fix or carry a decision (CLAUDE.md, rules awaiting physics)

decisions.text: This ticket is built first, before the rehearsal, because the inbox is what is burying him today and the predicate needs nothing the rehearsal builds.
decisions.by: Akien verbatim 2026-09-15: 'so we're getting buried in things akien has to look at again, and i can't keep up. My day job isn't doing well' + 'agreed on all counts' to CC's order (drain first)

intention: The operator's review lane holds only what his head has to settle: a berth whose ticket measurement has already closed leaves the lane by derivation, and troubles leave his lane for CC's.
why: Law 9's 2026-08-15 clause: 'anything settled by measurement trumps approvals by even me' — a berth under a PROVED ticket has nothing left for his approval to add. Telos: the system must not cost the one funding it has; Akien 2026-09-15: 'we're getting buried in things akien has to look at again, and i can't keep up.' Law 7: derived, never written, so a record of truth (his reviewed log) never collapses a measurement into an approval.
how: In cairn/machines/skill_block (pending_reviews) and cairn/tools/operator_inbox: read the live tickets once, map every berth id named by a ticket's from_idea / intent_berth / sorted_berth to that ticket's cursor, and filter out at read time every berth whose ticket rests at a terminal (PROVED, SUPERSEDED, RETIRED, DROPPED, KILLED, ABSORBED). A berth no ticket names stays pending (an idea or intent nobody cast is his to look at). Troubles render under the CC-owned lane the way open questions already do, unless a trouble carries an open question. Nothing is written: the reviewed log stays his voice only. Measured today: 57 pending, of which the eight from the two 2026-09-14 voyages sit under PROVED tickets.
falsifier: DONE when, measured by cairn/machines/skill_block/proofs/ and cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/: (1) in a scratch world, a berth named by a ticket at [PROVED] is absent from pending_reviews and one named by a ticket at [BUILDME] is present; (2) a berth no ticket names is present; (3) the reviewed log's bytes are identical before and after; (4) the operator banner renders troubles under a CC-owned lane and the operator lane's count excludes them; (5) live: the banner's ARTIFACTS AWAITING REVIEW count after the build equals the count of pending berths whose ticket is non-terminal or unnamed (today the eight under bc7b64626405, c5b6b128a376 and 9adc6fddf185 drain; the rest is a census the build takes). WRONG INTENT: Akien reports a decision he needed to see drained — one instance reds the ticket.
